history.period: century-old history per the devasthan (exact dates undocumented)
history.summary: Researched as the Shree Saunsthan Shantadurga Chamundeshwari Kudtari Mahamaya devasthan at Ghudo-Avedem, Quepem taluka, on the banks of the Kushavati river. Per its official site, the deities were originally at Sandival/Sodelv and Vanyachi Aangadi at Kushstali (today's Curtorim) and were moved during the Portuguese-era persecution; Shantadurga and Chamundeshwari are enshrined side by side in separate garbhagrihas. AMBIGUITY: the CSV name 'Shree Santeri Temple' is generic — it could equally refer to the registered Shree Santeri Shantadurga Gramdevi devasthan at Sheldem, Quepem (per a Goa government gazette), or to Santeri shrines attached to other complexes. Identity unconfirmed; verify on ground. Coordinates are for Quepem town as an approximation.

name: Shree Shantadurga Chamundeshwari Kudtari Mahamaya Devasthan
town_description: Avedem (near Ghudo) is a village in Quepem taluka, South Goa, on the banks of the Kushavati river. It hosts the Shantadurga-Chamundeshwari devasthan a few kilometres from Quepem town.
